sections.title: Overview
sections.text: Front-end engineering design turns a concept into a costable, buildable project. We establish the process design basis, develop P&IDs and equipment sizing, and produce the cost estimate and schedule the rest of the project is built on — so you go to sanction with the risks understood.

sections.title: Decisions made early are the cheap ones
sections.text: Getting the process basis, control philosophy and equipment selection right at the front end is what keeps the build on schedule and the plant safe. The expensive surprises are the ones found during commissioning.
